faq.question: What are your order placement hours?
faq.answer: You can browse products and place your order at any time, any day of the week.

faq.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
faq.answer: Delivery availability depends on our service coverage. You can check whether delivery is available to your address when entering your order details.

faq.question: Is there a minimum order value?
faq.answer: The minimum order value is EGP 20.

faq.question: How long does delivery take?
faq.answer: Delivery time varies depending on your address and product availability. Please contact customer service for an estimated delivery time.

faq.question: How can I track my order?
faq.answer: You can check your order status through the app if order tracking is available, or contact customer service for assistance.

faq.question: Can I modify my order after confirming it?
faq.answer: Please contact customer service as soon as possible to check whether your order can be modified before it is prepared or shipped.

faq.question: What should I do if I receive a damaged or incorrect product?
faq.answer: Please contact customer service and explain the issue, including your order details, so we can review the case and guide you through the appropriate next steps.

faq.question: How can I cancel my order?
faq.answer: Please contact customer service as soon as possible to check whether your order can be canceled, depending on its preparation status.

faq.question: What payment methods are available?
faq.answer: Cash on delivery is available in accordance with our current ordering policy.

faq.question: How can I contact customer service?
faq.answer: You can contact customer service using the contact details provided in the app for assistance with products, orders, and delivery.
